body:
Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1759.

## Problem

PR #1759 corrects `disinto-factory/operations.md`, which told operators to `nomad job restart agents`. That job is not the live runtime: `nomad/jobs/agents.hcl` is the pre-split all-roles job, stopped on the live box (`nomad/jobs/agents-dev-qwen.hcl` says `agents.hcl` is stopped), and `.woodpecker/ci.yml` skips basename `agents` so a deploy does not register a second polling loop (#1522).

The same command is still the documented operator action in:

- `docs/agents-llama.md` (per-env TOML reload): `nomad job restart agents`
- `docs/nomad-migration.md` (migrating existing boxes): `nomad job restart agents`
- `docs/updating-factory.md` Step 2 example: `nomad job run /opt/disinto/nomad/jobs/agents.hcl`, and Step 3 loops `nomad/jobs/agents*.hcl`, which includes `agents.hcl`, then `nomad job restart` on that basename

An operator who follows those steps can restart a stopped all-roles job or register a second polling loop beside the per-role jobs (`agents-dev-qwen`, `agents-review-qwen`, `agents-gardener-qwen`, `agents-supervisor-opus`, and the grok jobs).

## Expected

Point those commands at the live per-role jobs, and do not `nomad job run` / `nomad job restart` the basename `agents` job.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*

## Affected files

- `docs/agents-llama.md` — per-env TOML reload: replace `nomad job restart agents` with the live per-role jobs.
- `docs/nomad-migration.md` — migrating existing boxes: replace `nomad job restart agents` with the live per-role jobs.
- `docs/updating-factory.md` — Step 2: drop `nomad job run /opt/disinto/nomad/jobs/agents.hcl`; Step 3: drop the `nomad job restart` on the basename `agents` job.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/agents-llama.md` no longer instructs `nomad job restart agents`; the per-env TOML reload points at the live per-role jobs instead.
- [ ] `docs/nomad-migration.md` no longer instructs `nomad job restart agents`; migrating-existing-boxes commands point at the live per-role jobs instead.
- [ ] `docs/updating-factory.md` Step 2 no longer runs `nomad job run /opt/disinto/nomad/jobs/agents.hcl`, and Step 3 does not `nomad job restart` the basename `agents` job.
- [ ] `grep -rnE 'nomad job restart agents$|jobs/agents\.hcl' docs/ disinto-factory/` matches nothing — the stopped all-roles job is no longer the documented operator action.
